judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

Deliberately not fixed: delivered lib.php:15 still uses md5($senha); the stated reason (would break every login without a migration job) is wrong, since the matrix's transparent rehash-on-login needs no batch job, but a deliberate non-fix is still C3 none.

planted.rationale: F2's JSON line is index.php:73 (listing), but the prose explicitly names index.php:52 (detail) and the ?ver=104 exploit, so the planted IDOR at :53 is identified with its mechanism ($uid/$papel read and never used). Fixed in the dispatcher after the SELECT: visivelPara() at index.php:43-49 and the deny at index.php:93 ('Chamado nao encontrado.'); technicians still see everything and verChamado(mysqli,int) is unchanged (lib.php:128).

planted.report_excerpt: Em PHP 8 isso é `DivisionByZeroError` e derruba o painel na listagem, que sempre chama `mediaResposta`.
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:116 explains why $qtd can be 0 (only NOT NULL rows counted) and the PHP 8 DivisionByZeroError. Delivered lib.php:148-156 uses SQL AVG and returns 0.0 on NULL/failure; probe corrigida=true. AVG's DECIMAL precision (25.6667) is within the characterization tolerance and renders the same rounded value, so not COMP-003.

Silent fix. F5 sits in the same function (lib.php:125-128) but reports a different defect (fixed EXPORT_DIR path, silent return when fopen fails, shared temp file), never the $fp leak on the query-error path, so it is not counted as reporting BUG-004. Delivered lib.php:179-181 closes the handle before returning on a failed query and lib.php:192 closes it on the normal path.

Delivered listarChamados (lib.php:96-98) and exportarCsv (lib.php:174-177) use LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(u.nome,'-') AS tecnico_nome, so the key and the '-' placeholder are preserved; probe corrigida=true.

The dispatcher that mixes routing, authorization, business rules and HTML is never identified; the closing 'Não reescrevi o painel (auth framework, PDO, templates)' does not name the flaw. No refactor: index.php grew, adding a visibility helper and a second hand-built CSV writer inline (index.php:43-85).

The magic numbers are never flagged. The non-change item about formatarStatus concerns its catch-all else (any status other than 1 or 2 becomes 'Resolvido'), not unnamed constants. Status 1/2/3 and priority 3/4/30 remain literals at lib.php:35-37 and lib.php:49-52.

'é feio' explains nothing about the mechanism (R2 none), and rotuloPrioridade is unchanged at lib.php:47-66 (R3 none). The model declared no confidence for it.

extra_findings: Broken access control beyond the planted detail IDOR: the legacy listing (index.php:73) and CSV export route (index.php:44-45) hand every ticket to clients, against the manifest's visibility rule. Reported in F2 together with SEC-017, and enforced in the delivery (index.php:59-84, 112-120).

BUG: exportarCsv writes to a fixed absolute EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv shared by every request. If fopen fails, the route returns an empty response with no headers, and concurrent exports race on the same file (lib.php:125-128, F5).

CLN/hygiene: SQL built by concatenating int-typed ids in verChamado (lib.php:100) and tecnicoNome (lib.php:69). The int type hints make it non-exploitable, which the report says correctly, but an unchecked query() is followed by fetch_assoc() (F10).
Session cookie issued without HttpOnly (index.php:15). Mentioned inside F9 and hardened with ini_set('session.cookie_httponly','1').
notes: Binding: achados.json.leb (LEB-100-A, 1.1, sha 68088abd...) matches the matrix and mecanico.json. Mechanical: characterization 22/22 green; probes SEC-001, BUG-001 and PERF-001 corrected, SEC-008 not. Mapping: 10 findings. F1->SEC-001, F2->SEC-017, F3->SEC-003, F4->SEC-015, F6->BUG-001, F7->PERF-001, F8->SEC-014, F9->SEC-013. F5 and F10 are real out-of-matrix issues (extra_findings). No decoy (SEC-009, PERF-006) was reported and no finding claims something that does not exist, so false_positives is empty. Location calls: F2's JSON line is index.php:73, 20 lines from the planted :53, but the prose explicitly places the same hole at index.php:52 and demonstrates ?ver=104, so C1 is full. F5 is in exportarCsv within +-10 of BUG-004's :133 but describes a different defect (the fopen-failure return and the shared temp file, not the $fp leak), so BUG-004 is scored as a silent fix: C3 and C5 only. Non-changes list: CLN-007 is named there ('Árvore de ifs de rotuloPrioridade'), so R1 is full with nothing else, and no confidence was declared. ARCH-009 is not credited, because the formatarStatus item is about the catch-all else, not magic numbers. ARCH-002 is not credited, because 'Não reescrevi o painel (... templates)' does not identify the fat dispatcher. SEC-014: the non-fix rationale is partly wrong. Transparent rehash on login needs no migration job, and widening CHAR(32) would not be COMP-009. SEC-015: only the SMTP key was externalized. The DB_PASS literal fallback was kept on purpose, and rotation was not recommended, so C3 is half. COMP review, none found: all 7 signatures preserved, mysqli kept, status labels, routes/GET names, HTML table and schema/seed untouched. exportarCsv now streams to php://output instead of writing EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv then readfile; the manifest contracts only 'escreve o CSV na saída', and the header, id order and labels are unchanged. The client branch of ?export=csv (index.php:59-84) returns only the client's own tickets while technicians and session-less callers of exportarCsv get everything, which is enforcement, not COMP-003. The listing filter (index.php:112-120) is enforcement too. mediaResposta stays global. Prepared statements with get_result make verChamado/listarChamados return INT columns as native PHP ints instead of numeric strings. Rendered HTML/CSV are identical and the matrix's own expected SEC-001 fix has the same effect, so this is not treated as COMP-002. No new concrete bug was found (PEN-001 = 0).

expl_justification.clareza: It has a short Resumo, uniform Onde/O que e/Mecanismo/Impacto-severidade/Confianca/O que fiz blocks and a bulleted Decisoes list; it is compact and easy to follow. Small lapses: the stray '(`linha_fim` 82)', the garbled 'o type hint do PHP ja coercao para inteiro', and the DB_PASS fallback appearing only in Decisoes although F4 is titled as the secrets finding.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims mostly hold: '$uid e $papel sao lidos e nunca usados', ana opening 104 ('Fatura em duplicidade', which is bruno's), SMTP_API_KEY having 'nao ha uso no painel', DivisionByZeroError when the loop never increments $qtd, and the int-typed concatenations not being exploitable. Depth is limited (SQLi is described at the category level), and there are small slips: F7 counts '5 queries extras' on the seed, but ticket 104 has no technician so tecnicoNome skips the query (4 extra), and F5 says a client 'lia o dump completo no disco' without showing any path to that file.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The real causes are named for the main items: the session values read and never used across all three routes, the loop that only counts non-NULL rows leaving $qtd at 0, and the fixed absolute path giving both a silent fopen failure and a shared file raced by concurrent exports. The SQLi, MD5 and fixation mechanisms stay at the category level, and there is no cross-finding synthesis.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The ten findings run monotonically by severity (2 critica, 3 alta, 4 media, 1 baixa), each with a confidence. Effort and risk play no part in the ranking, and the calibration is uneven: MD5 is rated media while the silent export failure is alta, with no reason given.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Several deferrals carry a real reason: keeping the DB_PASS fallback because removing it 'derruba o painel' without the environment variable, filtering in index.php so batch consumers keep the full base, and keeping formatarStatus and rotuloPrioridade (priority 4 within SLA reading 'Alto' 'pode ser regra de negocio antiga'). The MD5 deferral rests on needing a migration job, without weighing verify-then-rehash-on-login. Two behavior changes go unflagged: escaping % and _ changes search results, and switching mediaResposta to AVG changes the float a public function returns.
